name: aihu-language
description: TypeScript tooling and editor integrations for Aihu Single File Components

scripts.build: bun run build:tsc && bun run build:language-server && bun run build:vscode
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:tsc && bun run typecheck:tsc && bun run typecheck:language-server && bun run typecheck:vscode
scripts.test: bun run build:tsc && bun run test:tsc && bun run test:language-server
scripts.package: bun run package:npm && bun run package:vscode
scripts.package:npm: bun pm pack --dry-run --cwd packages/tsc && bun pm pack --dry-run --cwd packages/language-server
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run check:boundaries && bun run check:package-manifests && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run package
